idea-plugin.name: HMX Language Server
idea-plugin.description:
Cross-layer language intelligence for the HMX framework inside PyCharm and IntelliJ IDEA. Resolves references across Python ORM models, XML views and data, Webx JS/Vue components, and security CSV access rules.

The plugin locates the hmx-lsp executable automatically: the hmx.lsp.path VM option, the HMX_LSP_PATH environment variable, a project-local .hmx/ directory, the user cache, PATH, and finally a source checkout.
